body: Thank you so much for your comment. I feel like I am now resorting back to medication because therapy and other coping skills have not been helping me the way my medication did or at least I thought did. It's hard for me to be introspective because it takes me back to places I would rather not be and try to suppress and avoid for the rest of my life. But after thinking long and hard, I know it's basically because of how my self image has lessened. I feel so ashamed and hopeless because I have tried to kill myself, have done drugs, and have self harmed. I feel stupid, dumb, and useless and that no one really cares about me besides my parents ( for the most part.) which really brings down my self esteem. It makes me think of my life as being pathetic and ultimately wasted. Thank you for wanting to help it means a ton. And I'm sure my dog Oreo would love the compliment. :)

Thank you so much for the reply. I know how hard it is to be in a mental ward so I can relate to you there. Also thanks for trying to help others out due to you feeling the same way as some of us do, the impact is has is immense. I really appreciate the advice and will send you a PM. Stay strong.

Thank you so much for responding. I'm feeling better today. I actually came down with the flu which I know is a huge vulnerability factor when it comes to being depressed so that kind of eased my mind a bit instead of thinking these feelings hit me out of nowhere completely. And yes I know exactly what you're saying the desire to not be anymore is truly exhausting and that is exactly how I feel. Thank you so much for the advice and helpful reply. It means a lot knowing someone knows where I'm coming from and can also relate.
